facts.fact: The IMPULSE study (J Glob Health 2025), assessing 20 district health offices in Uganda between November 2022 and July 2024, found 95% had a functional electronic system for data entry and analysis, and that all data offices used DHIS2 as the platform for key data analysis; sites were chosen purposively and are not nationally representative.

The IMPULSE study (J Glob Health 2025) found that over 75% of the 28 Ugandan facilities it assessed between November 2022 and July 2024 used a functional electronic system for routine data entry and analysis; the facilities were comprehensive emergency obstetric care sites from national hospitals to health centres, purposively chosen, and the exact Uganda share is in the supplement only.
facts.system: Electronic routine health information system (not named at facility level)

systems.tiers: All district health offices assessed (20 in Uganda) used it for key data analysis

note: Four-country study; only the Uganda figures are taken. No tier breakdown of the Ugandan facilities is given in the body, so no tiers or clinics fact.
